name: Pomodoro
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pomodoro in St. Anton am Arlberg**

Indulge in a true Italian culinary experience high up in the Alps! At **Pomodoro**, you’ll find authentic pasta, fresh seafood, and delicious wood-fired pizzas—all with a view of the breathtaking **Tirol** mountains.

Start your meal with a crisp **Aperol Spritz** or a refreshing **Prosecco** while soaking in the panoramic scenery. For the main course, savor handmade **Tagliatelle al Ragù** or **Spaghetti alle Vongole**, paired with a bold **Chianti Classico**. Don’t miss their famous **Tiramisu** for dessert—layers of coffee-soaked **Savoiardi** and velvety mascarpone, dusted with cocoa.

After dinner, warm up with a **Grappa** or **Espresso** on the cozy terrace. Whether you’re here for skiing in **St. Anton am Arlberg** or just escaping the hustle, **Pomodoro** brings a taste of Italy to the heart of the Alps.
